name: Edge

Launch.Predecessor: Moto Z series , Moto X series

Network.Technology: 2G EDGE, GPRS/3G HSPA, HSPA+/4G LTE, LTE+, 5G

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android 10, Current (Edge (2020)): Android 11, Current (Edge+ (2020)): Android 12
Platform.Chipset: Edge (2020): Qualcomm Snapdragon 765G, Edge+ (2020): Qualcomm Snapdragon 865
Platform.CPU: Octa-core, Edge (2020): 2.4 GHz (1x 2.4 GHz Kryo 475 Prime + 1x 2.2 GHz Kryo 475 Gold + 6x 1.8 GHz Kryo 475 Silver), Edge+ (2020): 2.84 GHz (1x 2.84 GHz + 3x 2.42 GHz + 4x 1.8 GHz Kryo 585)

Memory.RAM: Edge (2020): 4/6 GB RAM, Edge+ (2020): 12 GB RAM

Display.Display: 6.7 in, (385 ppi), OLED capacitive touchscreen, 16M colors (Edge (2020))/1B colors (Edge+ (2020)) , 90 Hz refresh rate, HDR10 (Edge (2020))/HDR10+ (Edge+ (2020))

Cameras.Rear camera: Edge (2020): 64 MP, f/1.8, 1/1.72", 0.8 μm (wide) + 16 MP, f/2.2, 13mm, 1.0 μm (ultrawide) + 8 MP, f/2.4, 52mm, 1.12 μm (telephoto) + ToF 3D (depth), PDAF, 2x optical zoom, 4K@30fps, 1080p@30/60fps, LED flash, panorama, HDR, Edge+ (2020): 108 MP, f/1.8, 1/1.33", 0.8 μm (wide) + 16 MP, f/2.2, 13mm, 1.0 μm (ultrawide) + 8 MP, f/2.4, 81mm, 1.12 μm (telephoto) + ToF 3D (depth), PDAF, gyro-EIS, OIS, 3x optical zoom, 6K@30fps, 4K@30fps, 1080p@30/60/120fps, dual-LED flash, panorama, HDR

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac (2.4 & 5 GHz)/802.11a/b/g/n/ac/6 (2.4 & 5 GHz), dual-band, WiFi direct, hotspot, Bluetooth v5.1, A2DP, Low-energy
